title: Urgent transition, urgent extraction? Global decarbonization, national governance, and local impacts in the Indonesian nickel industry
authors: Håkon da Silva Hyldmo et al.
method: Multi-sited qualitative fieldwork: 88 semi-structured interviews and six focus groups in Sorowako, Morowali and Kolaka; field periods 2021-2023; purposive/stratified plus snowball recruitment; thematic analysis corroborated with observation, policy documents, grey literature and media.
scope: Local communities and Indigenous peoples, civil society, mining/processing firms, local/regional/national political actors and policymakers.
limitations: Qualitative and non-probability sampling; not a prevalence estimate. Findings span multiple sites; anonymous quotations must not be assigned to a specific village unless the paper says so. Respondent-attributed impacts are not independent epidemiological or causal measurements.

title: Masyarakat Apresiasi Solusi Solutif: Bupati Morowali Pimpin Rapat Penyelesaian Lahan di Bahodopi
publication: Official county report, event and publication date 2025-09-09
method: Official meeting report; quotes a resident representative and lists nine claims discussed with company, village and county representatives.
scope: Pulondongan and Lere’ea hamlets, Bahodopi; PT Abadi Nikel Nusantara.
limitations: County-published account, not independent minutes or implementation audit; quoted representative is not a survey or authorization from all residents. Eight items reportedly agreed; one land-document issue remained pending.

title: Pemkab Morowali Rapat Bersama PT ADP, Tindak Lanjuti Keluhan Masyarakat Soal Dampak Lingkungan
method: County report of a meeting and signed agreement between county government and PT Alaska Dwipa Perdana.
scope: Solonsa Jaya, Wita Ponda, Morowali; alleged muddy runoff affecting rice fields and public/social facilities.
limitations: Government report of allegations and commitments; it does not independently establish environmental causation or verify that works and water-pipe repairs were completed.

title: Pemkab Morowali Gelar Rakor Bersama Tindaklanjuti Aksi Mogok Kerja SP-KBM PT WNI
method: County-reported coordination meeting after a three-day strike; records attendees, agreed points and unresolved requests.
scope: SP-KBM and PT Wangxiang Nickel Industri, with county labor office, industrial-relations mediator and labor inspector.
limitations: Official report, not the signed minutes or a later compliance check. An industrial labor dispute is an analogous negotiation case, not direct proof of nickel-quota bargaining rules.

title: Morowali 2024 stunting audit dissemination and announced APBD allocation
method: County report of a local planning/evaluation meeting; official statement reports an APBD allocation of IDR 68,141,817,180 and a 2025 target.
scope: District and village health actors and stunting coordination in Morowali.
limitations: An announced allocation is not verified disbursement or expenditure; not a nickel-specific budget and not a measure of fiscal headroom for other programmes.

title: Buruknya Wajah Hilirisasi Nikel: Survei Lintas Serikat Ungkap Carut Marut Kondisi Kerja di Morowali
authors: Koalisi serikat pekerja; published by KPonline on 2026-08-18
method: Coalition reports a random-sample survey of 1,078 nickel mining and processing workers; the public story gives summary counts.
scope: Industrial workers in the Morowali nickel area; K3 risk, health access, wages, hours and basic rights.
limitations: Union-coalition publication; sampling frame, questionnaire, response rate and microdata are not supplied on the page. Self-reported results are not an independent workplace audit; not evidence that training produced jobs or livelihood gains.

title: Indonesia: The downstreaming dilemma
authors: Hilman Palaon and Robert Walker, Lowy Institute
method: Expert commentary based on interviews with communities and stakeholders, with selected BPS labour-market statistics cited.
scope: Southeast Sulawesi province, especially the nickel belt; traditional sectors, industrial jobs and local workforce composition.
limitations: Not a peer-reviewed study; interview sampling is not specified on the page. Province-level claims must not be transferred directly to Morowali or read as a unified community preference.
